prompt:
A web console page for an autonomous software factory, seen whole. The top
bar is decided and fixed: one 44 px strip between two 1 px hairline rules,
quiet small-capitals words, no boxes or pills around links. Left to right:
"FACTORY CONSOLE" (the product name, slightly heavier), the project select
"ai-software-factory-code ▾", then the one bordered word "New task"; a wide
gap; the figures group "COSTS · METRICS · RESOURCES"; a wide gap; the
running group "SETTINGS · POLICY · NOTIFICATIONS"; at the right a moon
icon, "sebastian", "LOG OUT". The open page's word "METRICS" is cyan with a
short underline beneath it; no other bar word is colored. The page below
fills the rest.

The page's exact content, and nothing more — do not invent rows, sections,
numbers, badges, filters, search boxes, pagination or chart kinds beyond
the sparks the content names. Only the content between the CONTENT markers.
All text must be crisp and legible, spelled exactly as given.
Direction HEADLINE. One wide chart answers the page's first question before
any row is read: throughput and deploys over the window as one quiet
stepped area with the previous 28 days ghosted beside or beneath it as a
fainter trace, its two figures (31 cards +6, 23 deploys +4) monospaced at
the chart's right. Beneath it the four other sections as ROWS' figure rows
(name · value · move · spark). The window control sits at the top right.
The point: one glance says how the work is moving; the rows carry the rest.
PALETTE (light): page background #f1ece0 (warm paper), no page gradient;
panel background where a surface is needed #faf6ec; hairline rules #d8cfba
(1 px); text #0f1d33; muted text #5d6b80; faint text #7a8698; teal #0a6a80
reserved for the open page's word in the bar and for links, nothing else;
burnt amber #8a4f00 only where a state needs attention, and sparingly.
Sparks and bars are instrument traces, not decoration: they read as quiet
ink (muted or faint text colour), never as a saturated accent. Words in a
13 px humanist sans; every figure, ID, unit and time in a tabular monospace.
Dense but calm: a mission-control readout, not a marketing page. Rendered
at 1440×900, desktop.
